instrument: Temporary moratorium on large-scale data centers (Aug 27, 2026)
summary: 155-day moratorium on development or conversion activity for data centers with electrical capacity of 10 MW or more, and a prohibition on converting warehouses and industrial buildings of 200,000 sq ft or more to data center use, while staff study infrastructure, zoning and site standards. Adopted unanimously.

source.citation: City of Savannah council agenda, Aug 27, 2026 (item 27)

notes: Expires about late January 2027 (derived). City has accepted a permit for a smaller data center under 25,000 sq ft. Contact: Bridget Lidy, Planning & Urban Design Director.
